name: CL Intraday Reaction to EIA Petroleum Inventory Report
description: Measures WTI crude oil (CL) absolute price moves at +1, +5, +15, and +30 minutes after the weekly EIA petroleum inventory release (Wednesdays ~10:30 AM ET). Detects release bars using Wednesday + time_of_day 629-631 min (America/New_York). Reports avg absolute move in both % and $/bbl across all 4 windows, with event markers per release.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CL INTRADAY REACTION TO EIA PETROLEUM INVENTORY REPORT
# =============================================================================
# EIA Petroleum Status Report releases every Wednesday ~10:30 AM ET.
# Detection: Wednesday (day_of_week == 2) AND time_of_day in [629, 631] min ET.
# This window catches the 10:30 bar regardless of open vs close stamping.
#
# Measures ABSOLUTE price move at +1, +5, +15, +30 minutes after release bar:
#   - % move: abs((close_at_N - close_at_release) / close_at_release)
#   - $/bbl move: abs(close_at_N - close_at_release)
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Summary table: avg absolute move (% and $/bbl) per window
#   2. Bar chart: avg absolute % move across 4 windows
#   3. Event markers: one per release with all 4 windows
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT (NoAdjustment — we want raw prices for $/bbl moves) ===
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    i_offset=0
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c

# === EIA RELEASE BAR DETECTION ===
# Wednesday = day_of_week 2 (ISO: 0=Mon, 1=Tue, 2=Wed, 3=Thu, 4=Fri)
bar_ts = index()
day_of_week = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week)(bar_ts)
time_min = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)

is_wednesday = day_of_week == 2
is_eia_window = time_min >= 629 and time_min <= 631

# Release bar: Wednesday AND in the 10:30 ET window
is_eia_release = is_wednesday and is_eia_window

# === FORWARD PRICE MOVES (measured from release bar) ===
# close << N = close N bars in the future (intentional look-ahead for measurement)
# close_release = close on the release bar itself
# We compute all moves ON the release bar using the << operator

close_release = close
close_p1  = close << 1
close_p5  = close << 5
close_p15 = close << 15
close_p30 = close << 30

# Absolute % moves (raw decimal, e.g. 0.005 = 0.5%)
abs_pct_1  = abs((close_p1  - close_release) / close_release)
abs_pct_5  = abs((close_p5  - close_release) / close_release)
abs_pct_15 = abs((close_p15 - close_release) / close_release)
abs_pct_30 = abs((close_p30 - close_release) / close_release)

# Absolute $/bbl moves
abs_dol_1  = abs(close_p1  - close_release)
abs_dol_5  = abs(close_p5  - close_release)
abs_dol_15 = abs(close_p15 - close_release)
abs_dol_30 = abs(close_p30 - close_release)

# === FILTER TO RELEASE BARS ONLY ===
# All metrics are sparse — only non-NaN on EIA release bars
r_pct_1  = where(is_eia_release and is_valid(abs_pct_1),  abs_pct_1)
r_pct_5  = where(is_eia_release and is_valid(abs_pct_5),  abs_pct_5)
r_pct_15 = where(is_eia_release and is_valid(abs_pct_15), abs_pct_15)
r_pct_30 = where(is_eia_release and is_valid(abs_pct_30), abs_pct_30)

r_dol_1  = where(is_eia_release and is_valid(abs_dol_1),  abs_dol_1)
r_dol_5  = where(is_eia_release and is_valid(abs_dol_5),  abs_dol_5)
r_dol_15 = where(is_eia_release and is_valid(abs_dol_15), abs_dol_15)
r_dol_30 = where(is_eia_release and is_valid(abs_dol_30), abs_dol_30)

# Event count (for table header context)
release_count = where(is_eia_release, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Table 1: Event count ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EIA Release Events Detected',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Total EIA Releases'],
        col_headers=['Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='EIA Reaction',
    order=0
)(release_count)

# --- Table 2: Avg absolute move per window (% and $/bbl) ---
# Standard mode: 8 inputs → 2 rows × 4 columns
# Row 0: % move, Row 1: $/bbl move
# Columns: +1min, +5min, +15min, +30min
# NOTE: r_pct_* are raw decimals (0.005 = 0.5%). Use DecimalFormat with dp=4
# to avoid PercentFormat × 100 trap. Label columns with "%" in header.
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Avg Absolute Move After EIA Release',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Avg Abs Move (%)', 'Avg Abs Move ($/bbl)'],
        col_headers=['+1 Min', '+5 Min', '+15 Min', '+30 Min'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='EIA Reaction',
    order=1
)(r_pct_1, r_pct_5, r_pct_15, r_pct_30, r_dol_1, r_dol_5, r_dol_15, r_dol_30)

# --- Chart: Avg absolute % move across 4 windows ---
# Series mode: 4 bars, one per window. No label input.
xy_bars(
    title='How Fast Does CL Move After EIA? Avg Absolute % Move by Window',
    category='EIA Reaction',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    y_axis_label='Avg Absolute Move (decimal)',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 Min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 Min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+15 Min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30 Min', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(r_pct_1, r_pct_5, r_pct_15, r_pct_30)

# --- Event Markers: one per EIA release ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EIA Petroleum Inventory Release',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='+1 Min Abs Move (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='CL Price at Release', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+1 Min Abs Move ($/bbl)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+5 Min Abs Move (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+5 Min Abs Move ($/bbl)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+15 Min Abs Move (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+15 Min Abs Move ($/bbl)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+30 Min Abs Move (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+30 Min Abs Move ($/bbl)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_eia_release, r_pct_1, close_release, r_dol_1, r_pct_5, r_dol_5, r_pct_15, r_dol_15, r_pct_30, r_dol_30)
